query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `perique_compounds` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `formula` varchar(100),
  `concentration_pct` decimal(10,4),
  `category` varchar(100),
  `subcategory` varchar(100),
  `olfactory_notes` text,
  `perfumery_potential` varchar(50),
  `dosage_perfumery` varchar(50),
  `origin` varchar(255),
  `is_new_tobacco_isolate` boolean DEFAULT false,
  `source_reference` varchar(500),
  `created_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `perique_compounds_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
